gaps.sentence: Everyone says she takes ___ her grandmother.
gaps.explanation: take after a relative = resemble them in character/looks.

gaps.sentence: She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The company was ___ up by a larger rival last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Take over/take up a company' — here 'was taken up' = absorbed by a bigger firm.

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
